title: Altrex GMS
desc: End-to-end cloud gym management SaaS with automated WhatsApp billing alerts, Razorpay payment links, and biometric facial recognition turnstile sync.
challenge: Fitness centers were losing recurring revenue due to manual spreadsheet tracking, missed fee follow-ups, and disconnected biometric access hardware.
deliverables: Multi-tenant cloud architecture with strict PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) for multi-branch gyms
Automated Meta WhatsApp Cloud API engine sending fee reminders, receipts, and Razorpay payment links
Real-time webhook synchronization with Hikvision MinMoe & eSSL facial recognition terminals
Executive financial dashboard tracking Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), active cohorts, and churn

title: Tencio Menu Hub
desc: Real-time QR digital menu and table-service SaaS featuring zero-refresh live kitchen updates and native background Web Push waiter alerts.
challenge: Restaurants using static PDF QR menus struggled with slow mobile downloads, outdated item availability, and no digital way for tables to call staff.
deliverables: Instant-loading Next.js 15 Server-Side Rendered (SSR) mobile menu tailored for table QR scans
Bi-directional Supabase Realtime WebSockets to reflect sold-out items and price changes without refreshing
Native Service Worker & Web Push API integration for one-tap 'Call Waiter' and 'Request Bill' alerts
Multi-tenant restaurant admin dashboard with category scheduling and tiered subscription logic

title: Men's Club Store
desc: High-performance retail storefront and seasonal lookbook engineered with Framer Motion transitions and Schema.org local business structured data.
challenge: A premier men's formal wear and custom tailoring brand needed to capture high-intent local search traffic and convert mobile browsers into in-store visitors.
deliverables: Interactive digital lookbooks showcasing formal wear, wedding ethnic collections, and bespoke tailoring
Rich Schema.org JSON-LD local business metadata for top visibility on regional Google searches
Next.js media optimization pipeline delivering crisp apparel photography with zero layout shift
Direct mobile conversion flows with one-tap WhatsApp catalog inquiry and store navigation

title: Bloomspace Interiors
desc: A luxury digital showroom engineered for an Abu Dhabi interior design firm featuring a Sanity headless CMS studio and Snapchat Pixel attribution.
challenge: The UAE design team needed an editorial-grade digital showroom capable of serving high-resolution interior portfolios fast on mobile while managing content in-house.
deliverables: Decoupled Sanity.io Headless CMS studio enabling non-technical staff to publish new projects independently
Scroll-linked editorial reveals and smooth gallery transitions built with Framer Motion
Production Snapchat Pixel conversion tracking tailored for UAE social ad attribution
Serverless lead capture workflows for residential and commercial fit-out consultations

title: Nadan AI
desc: An intelligent fitness companion and multilingual calorie tracker supporting English, Malayalam, and Manglish food queries via Gemini Flash AI.
challenge: Global nutrition apps fail to recognize regional South Indian cuisine or break when users search using phonetic Manglish spellings.
deliverables: Tri-lingual search engine supporting English, Malayalam script, and phonetic Manglish queries
Sub-millisecond local fuzzy search indexing using Fuse.js with custom phonetic weight tuning
Google Gemini Flash LLM integration returning structured JSON macro-nutrient breakdowns for custom meals
Mobile-first daily calorie and protein goal tracking dashboard

title: Sol & Tree
desc: Comprehensive corporate profile brochure and visual identity system crafted with editorial typography, custom layouts, and print-ready specifications.
challenge: Sol & Tree needed a cohesive, executive-level company profile brochure that communicated brand credibility across both B2B digital presentations and physical print.
deliverables: Multi-page corporate profile brochure layout with custom grid geometry and visual hierarchy
Cohesive color palette, typographic scale, and custom iconography system
Print-ready CMYK artwork alongside interactive, compressed digital PDF decks for client pitching
